annotations.title: What to ask before finding a lawyer

description: Use first when someone asks for a lawyer but the state or type of legal matter is unclear ("I need a lawyer", "help me with my landlord"). Returns the few questions still needed (state, matter type, location, timing, budget) and what was understood. Does not answer the legal question and stores nothing.

budget_max.description: Total budget the user mentioned, in US dollars

client_side.description: Which side the user is on. ESQ Matching Engine has no record of which side lawyers usually represent, so results carry a warning to ask.

consultation_by.description: Latest date the user wants a first consultation

deadline_date.description: A deadline the USER reported (hearing, filing, response). ESQ Matching Engine does not verify or calculate deadlines.

description.description: Short description of the legal need in the user's words. Used only to pick a practice area; not stored.

include_unconfirmed_practice_area.description: Also include licensed lawyers whose practice areas are not on record (labeled clearly)

language_required.description: True if the language is essential, not just preferred

max_consultation_fee.description: 0 means the user wants a free first consultation

practice_area.description: Practice area, e.g. 'Landlord-Tenant Law', 'Family Law', 'Criminal Law'

priorities.description: What matters most, in order. Shifts ranking weights.

reduced_fee_eligible.description: User may qualify for pro bono, legal aid or reduced fees

remote_ok.description: User is willing to work with a lawyer remotely (phone or video) anywhere in the state

state.description: US state, two-letter code or name, e.g. CA or California

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code, only if the user agreed to share it

name: get_matching_requirements
title: What to ask before finding a lawyer
